title: IntentEventPayload
description: Payload of a WorldEvent of type `intent`: one state change of an intent, published by the Body (spec 5.3, section 7). The sink projects it into the Postgres `intents` table, moving only forward: accepted, then running, then completed, failed or cancelled. paused and interrupted are events only, because the table does not store them. source_event_id derives from (intent_id, state), so a retry dedups.

detail.description: Why, in plain text, for example the failure message.
